$comment: One source of truth for every atlas TI-Toolbox ships in MNI space. tit/atlas/manifest.py is the only reader; tit/atlas/constants.py, tit/catalog.py and the ROI picker all resolve through it, so an atlas is described in exactly one place. Fields: file (basename in this directory), kind ('volume' | 'surface' -- what targeting flow the UI must route it to), template (the MNI template the atlas is defined in), labels (sidecar LUT/label table), license, attribution, redistribution ('yes' | 'no (<reason>)'), citation. See README.md for the full survey and docs/wiki/atlases.md for the user-facing page.
